title: Sabrina Original Motion Picture Soundtrack CD John Williams Sting 1995 A&M
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Sabrina - Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (A&M Records, 1995).
The Sydney Pollack film starring Harrison Ford and Julia Ormond.

Original music composed and conducted by John Williams. "Moonlight" is
performed by Sting, and "How Can I Remember?" by Michael Dees. Album
produced by John Williams except "Moonlight," produced by Kim Turner
and Sting.

The score weaves in standards including "La Vie En Rose," "The Shadow of
Your Smile," "Call Me Irresponsible" and "Stella By Starlight." See the
photographed back insert for the full track listing.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
